name: Interpretation

subjectOf.text: Regulatory assets under management is an unstable reporting concept: commenters split evenly on whether Form PF's RAUM questions required them to interpret the term in order to answer.
subjectOf.abstract: Commenters were equally split on whether Form PF questions pertaining to calculating RAUM required filers to interpret RAUM for purposes of completing Form PF.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Private Fund Disclosures Under the Dodd-Frank Act (2014). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2447306

subjectOf.text: Because shareholder agreements are designed to displace corporate formalities such as majority rule, it is reasonable to require that the intended degree of deviation be set out explicitly in the agreement.
subjectOf.abstract: When a shareholder agreement is included in the corporate charter or bylaws, it becomes subject to amendment as provided therein or by statute.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Shareholder Agreements - National Report of the United States of America (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3017612
scope_conditions: agreements that deviate from default corporate norms

subjectOf.text: Smart contracts fail to accommodate human business interaction because code does not follow the same logic on similar terms as natural human language, so the flexibility in interpreting intent that human dealings require cannot be ensured.
subjectOf.abstract: Human interaction requires flexibility in interpreting intent that cannot be ensured by smart contracting because smart contract code does not follow the same logic on similar terms as natural human language.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralization - A Primer on the New Economy (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3406323
scope_conditions: human business interactions requiring interpretation of intent

subjectOf.text: Interpretation of the Codex must give priority to the intent of the parties and to the specific context of the legal status or act in question, rather than to a literal or purely systemic reading.

subjectOf.text: Where the Codex or the applicable law is applied largely automatically, the human understanding of the rule prevails over the outcome produced by that automated application, so automated execution never becomes the final authority on meaning.
